===== PROBE =====
name: system.proxmox_qm_config
started_utc: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
root_mode: root
run_as: root
requires: qm
timeout_s: 120
runner: timeout -k 5 120 bash -o pipefail -c <command>
===== COMMAND =====
for id in $(qm list | awk 'NR > 1 {print $1}'); do echo "== VM $id"; qm config "$id"; done
